```{python}

import pynapple as nap
import numpy as np
tsdframe = nap.TsdFrame(
    t=[1,2,3,4,5], 
    d=[[1,2],
       [1,2],
       [1,3],
       [2,1],
       [1,2]],
    columns=["A", "B"]
)
tsdframe[:, 1]
```
